title: darkFlash DPW90M MATX Gaming PC Case

comparisons.notes: Exact DPW90M white; MPN DF-DPW90M-WH-3F; 3 ARGB fans; sold/shipped by darkFlash Official Store
Official US store DPW90M; listed $96.99–$99.99 by color; same MATX curved-glass 3-fan case

writeup: Woot has a new darkFlash DPW90M white Micro-ATX gaming case, MPN DF-DPW90M-WH-3F, with three ARGB fans, a curved-glass side panel, and dual 360mm radiator support for $47.90. The same white DPW90M is $84.99 in stock at Newegg from the darkFlash Official Store, and the official US shop lists it at $96.99, so this is about $37.09 and 43 percent below the lowest verified street price. Only five are left on this drop, with a limit of ten per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Verifier marked amazon_asin_verified B0D4QRXGSY as an exact match for the darkFlash DPW90M MATX gaming PC case.
